objective: Test one fixed convertible-bond ETF allocation candidate against a strict 5% historical price-proxy falsification hurdle; never guarantee, forecast, or claim an investor return.

pre_observation_disclosure.consequence: Any positive output remains exploratory and is not independent out-of-sample evidence.

economic_design.distinct_from_r5: No momentum, relative ranking, asset-selection, timing switch, or R5 input/result reuse; this is a fixed quarterly-rebalanced convertible-bond plus government-bond allocation.

products.factual_assertion_to_verify: Haifutong SSE Investment Grade Convertible Bond and Exchangeable Bond ETF; SSE Investment Grade Convertible Bond and Exchangeable Bond Index.
Bosera CSI Convertible Bond and Exchangeable Bond ETF; CSI Convertible Bond and Exchangeable Bond Index.
Guotai SSE 5-Year Treasury Bond ETF; SSE 5-Year Treasury Bond Index.

economic_design.universe_claim: The three identifiers are the complete fixed implementation of C8-T1, not an open universe, product ranking, or recommendation.

data_protocol.proxy_boundary: Official retrospective close observations do not establish PIT availability, total return, NAV/IOPV, distributions, corporate actions, market state, costs, capacity, fill, entitlement or action.

rules.start_timing: Initial targets are established at the first common observation close; only subsequent observations earn a return.
rules.rebalance: After the last common observation in each March, June, September, and December, the next common observation first earns old-holding return and then rebalances at its close; new weights affect following observations only.
rules.cost_boundary: Fixed 30bp times one-way turnover is an illustrative stress load, not verified personal cost.

requirements: Every complete calendar-year net unitized change is at least 5%.
Every valid 1260-common-observation rolling annualized net unitized change is at least 5%.
No input, alignment, or accounting failure occurs.
falsification.positive_result_boundary: A non-falsified price proxy cannot approve allocation, holding, action, or a return claim.

paper_execution_design.schedule: Quarterly rebalancing only after live product and account gates are documented.
paper_execution_design.lot_rule: Paper quantities are rounded down to 100-share ETF lots; residual is recorded as unallocated and earns no assumed return.
paper_execution_design.order_style: Limit-order paper instruction only; no market-order chasing.
no_trade_gates: unknown NAV/IOPV or stale official reference

stop_and_invalidation.ordinary_trade: Quarterly restoration to fixed targets only.
research_invalidation: falsification under formal entitled PIT total-return/event/execution replay
proxy cannot account for distributions, adjustments, suspension, costs, settlement, or nonfills

action_requirements: entitled PIT total-return and event data
prospective paper observation with nonfill records
allowed_output: Research-only price-proxy result and evidence gap assessment; portfolio_q remains 0.
